inputs.prompt: The exact same anime girl as the provided reference images, identical face, hairstyle, outfit and body proportions. Full body standing, identical framing and constant subject scale. Static locked camera, flat unchanged lighting and exposure. A solid uniform chroma key green background matching the reference, no background shadows or gradients. Keep the head, torso, hips and feet at the same screen positions; only the specifically requested local motion is allowed. Preserve clean stable fingers and garment details. No zoom, camera motion, body resizing, walking, scene changes, extra limbs, extra objects, text, overlays, glow, particles or motion blur. Small fluent movements with gentle acceleration and deceleration, no sudden pose changes. The same calm hands-at-rest speaking loop as the base reference: hands, shoulders and head remain still, with three to five small mouth cycles and brief closed-mouth intervals. Add just one gentle natural blink near the middle, eyes open before and after. No head dip or hand gesture accompanies the blink. The last frame matches the first resting pose, mouth shape and open eyes. This variant is for occasional playback; it will not be selected on every loop.
